# Demo Resource

Local example file:

- Bundled demo: [demo.odin](./demo.odin)

## Why It Matters
- This bundled file is a dense local example corpus for Odin language features and standard usage patterns.
- It is useful when the official docs mention a feature but do not show enough examples.
- It serves as a practical feature reference for this skill.

## How to Use It
- Start with the [Demo topic index](./demo-topic-index.md) to find the right section and approximate line range.
- Search the file by feature name, operator, type, or directive.
- Prefer it for worked examples of control flow, polymorphism, `using`, context, unions, matrices, bit sets, SOA, foreign bindings, and other advanced language constructs.
- Use it to extract minimal runnable snippets after confirming semantics in the official docs.

## Current Coverage
- The bundled file includes examples for core language basics, control flow, struct and union usage, parametric polymorphism, `using`, context, array programming, threading, matrices, bit fields, directives, and more.
